title: RaspAssistant as an Agentic Framework for Automating Adsorption Simulation Research in Porous Materials
abstract: arXiv:2610.27572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Porous-material adsorption studies require coordinated structure preparation, force-field selection, simulation, validation, and interpretation, making end-to-end automation difficult. We test whether RaspAssistant, a hierarchical multi-agent framework, can carry an adsorption study from force-field preparation through validation and downstream separation analysis. Across twelve multi-agent workflow-reproduction runs spanning four adsorption and separation benchmarks, overall scores ranged from 8.50 to 10.00 on a rubric evaluating workflow correctness, simulation validity, and analysis consistency. In a separate eight-case force-field extraction benchmark, the mean weighted score was 0.967, combining parameter agreement and RASPA readiness. translated_title: RaspAssistant：一个用于自动化多孔材料吸附模拟研究的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 多孔材料吸附研究需要协调进行结构制备、力场选择、模拟、验证和解释，这使得端到端的自动化变得困难。我们测试了RaspAssistant——一个分层多智能体框架——能否将吸附研究从力场制备一直推进到验证及下游分离分析。在涵盖四个吸附与分离基准的十二次多智能体工作流复现运行中，依据评估工作流正确性、模拟有效性和分析一致性的评分标准，总分为8.50至10.00分。在一项独立的包含八个案例的力场提取基准测试中，结合参数一致性与RASPA可用性的加权平均得分为0.967。在开放式研究中，该系统诊断并改进了乙炔力场，并在将CO₂力场与MFI实验数据进行验证后，筛选了197种通过自动……的纯硅沸石。
tldr: RaspAssistant是一个分层多智能体框架，能够将多孔材料吸附模拟研究从力场制备、模拟验证到下游分离分析全流程自动化，并在多项基准测试中取得接近满分的成绩。
en_tdlr: RaspAssistant is a hierarchical multi-agent framework that automates adsorption simulation research in porous materials end-to-end—from force-field preparation through validation to downstream separation analysis—achieving near-perfect scores across multiple benchmarks.
